title: Lead, Process Technology Support
description:
**Position Title: Lead\- Process Technology \& Support**
**Job Objective \-**
 To provide technical expertise in pharmaceutical process technology, process development, scale\-up, process optimization, equipment commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer technical support, predominantly involving Fluid bed equipment. The role works closely with Customers, Sales, Engineering, Service, Automation, R\&D, Production and cross\-functional teams to ensure successful implementation and optimization of pharmaceutical processing solutions.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities \-**
* Develop and optimize pharmaceutical processes involving High Shear, Dry and Fluid Bed Granulation, Fluid bed Drying, Wurster Coating, Tangential Granulation and Coating, Hot Melt Granulation, Tablet Coating, etc
* Execute laboratory, pilot and commercial\-scale trials and support technology transfer and scale\-up activities.
* Lead/support FAT, SAT, commissioning, qualification and start\-up of processing equipment at customer sites.
* Provide technical troubleshooting, root cause analysis and CAPA for process, equipment, automation and instrumentation issues.
* Act as technical interface with customers and support process demonstrations, validation and technical discussions.
* Collaborate with Sales, Engineering, Service, Automation, Quality and Production teams for project execution and problem resolution.
* Prepare technical reports, trial reports, case studies, SOPs and best\-practice documents.
* Drive continuous improvement, productivity enhancement, customer satisfaction and competitor benchmarking initiatives.
* Support business development through technical solutions, aftermarket opportunities and spares generation.


**Key Result Areas**
* Successful execution of customer trials, commissioning and qualification activities.
* Timely resolution of customer technical issues.
* Successful process scale\-up and technology transfer projects.
* Improvement in process performance and customer satisfaction.
* Generation of business opportunities in Pharmaceutical, Food, Feed, Nutraceutical and Chemical sectors.
* Development of technical solutions, case studies and standardized best practices


**Key Interfaces**
**Internal Interfaces**
**External Interfaces**
* Cross\-functional collaboration: Working with internal CFT groups like Sales, Automation \& Controls, Design, NPD, QAC, Aftermarket or operations
* Pharma Companies
* Non\-Pharma Companies

title: Bid Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 SLK Group of Companies is a diversified and fast\-growing enterprise in India, with operations across facility management, automotive, infrastructure, manufacturing, renewable energy, and pharmaceuticals. The Group delivers customized, high\-quality solutions to commercial, residential, and industrial clients, supporting industrial growth and infrastructure development. Its portfolio includes automotive components, upcoming vehicle retail, premium residential projects, and essential manufactured products such as food colors, wall paints, and street lighting systems. SLK Group is also committed to clean energy through solar panels and windmills, and supplies regulated pharmaceutical products. Guided by customer focus, technology\-driven innovation, and ethical business practices, the Group positions itself as a trusted, forward\-looking organization for long\-term careers.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Bid Specialist role based in Pimpri Chinchwad. The Bid Specialist will manage end\-to\-end bid and tender processes, including identifying opportunities, reviewing tender documents, and coordinating internal inputs to develop competitive proposals. Day\-to\-day work includes preparing and structuring bid responses, drafting and refining technical and commercial proposals, and ensuring compliance with client requirements and company standards. The role involves close collaboration with sales, operations, finance, and technical teams to gather accurate information and costings, as well as maintaining bid trackers, documentation, and submission timelines. The Bid Specialist will also support post\-submission follow\-ups, respond to clarifications, and contribute to continuous improvement of bidding strategies and templates.
 



  





  





 ANNUAL CTC :\- 7,80,000 /\-
 



  





  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong skills in Bid Processes and Tender Management, including familiarity with government and private sector tendering.
* Candidates should possess hands\-on experience in Bid Preparation and Proposal Writing, with the ability to tailor responses to diverse industry sectors.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, including clear written business English and effective stakeholder coordination.
* Experience with documentation control, data analysis, and MS Office (especially Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) is highly beneficial.
* Attention to detail, time management, and the ability to work under strict deadlines in a structured, process\-driven environment are essential.
* A bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, commerce, or a related field is preferred; prior experience in bidding or tender coordination is an advantage.
* Understanding of facility management, infrastructure, manufacturing, automotive, or renewable energy sectors will be considered an added benefit.

title: Content Writer
description:
**Company Description**
 Prometteur is a leading global systems integrator and business transformation consulting organisation. Prometteur helps companies innovate and transform by leveraging its unique insights, differentiated services, and flexible partnering models. The company is among the Top mobile application development companies in India, and also a pioneer in web application development and Automation Testing. Prometteur has gained the trust of more than 300 offshore clients from 30\+ countries worldwide and has become a trustworthy software partner.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Description:
   

  

 We are looking for a creative and enthusiastic Content Writer to join our team. The ideal candidate should have strong writing skills, a willingness to learn, and an interest in creating engaging content across digital platforms. Candidates with a technical, literature, or media background and exposure to iGaming or online gaming content will be an added advantage.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Create high\-quality, engaging, and original content for blogs, websites, articles, and marketing materials
* Research industry\-related topics, especially in technology and online gaming/iGaming
* Edit and proofread content to ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency
* Follow brand tone, style guidelines, and SEO best practices
* Collaborate with marketing, SEO, and design teams to develop content ideas
* Stay updated with content trends, digital marketing practices, and gaming industry updates


 Required Skills \& Qualifications:
   

  

* 1\-2 Year of experience in content writing
* Excellent written communication skills in English
* Ability to research topics and convert information into engaging content
* Basic understanding of SEO concepts is a plus
* Strong attention to detail and eagerness to learn Knowledge about writing blogs, webpages, business articles, whitepapers, etc., in brand style and format.
* Basic understanding of SEO and keywords usage.
* Understanding of content strategy, mapping, and branding.
* Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple tasks while collaborating smoothly with the design and marketing team.
* Experience in IT/SaaS/iGaming would be add\-on.


**Qualifications**
 Technical background (BE, BTech, or equivalent) OR
   

  

* Literature / Media background (MA in English, Mass Communication, Journalism, or related fields)
